chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdul Malik, from Haydar, from Hamza ibn Humran, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'Who inherited the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Fatima (peace be upon her), and she inherited the chattels of the house, and the assets, and all that which belonged to him (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.كُلَّ مَا كَانَ لَهُ: all that which belonged to him
key_terms.مَتَاعَ الْبَيْتِ: chattels of the house / household goods

ai.seo_question: Who inherited the Prophet Muhammad's movable property and household goods according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights Fatima al-Zahra’s (peace be upon her) status as the primary inheritor of the Prophet’s personal effects, specifically 'matāʿ al-bayt' (household goods) and 'al-khurthiyy' (movable property), a distinction often cited in Shia jurisprudence to differentiate her inheritance from that of the general community. Scholars note that this specific bequest underscores her unique spiritual and domestic authority within the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the concept of hereditary leadership (Imamate) passing through her lineage. The emphasis on tangible assets rather than land or territory reflects the historical context of the Prophet’s modest estate at the time of his passing.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abdul Malik, from Hayday, from Hamza Bin Humran who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Who inherited Rasool-Allah<sup>saw</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Fatima<sup>asws</sup>, and she<sup>asws</sup> inherited chattels of the house, and the assets, and all that which belonged to him<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan from Ali ibn Asbat from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn ‘Abd al-Malik, Hayde r from Hamzah ibn Humran who has narrated the following:

“I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ’Who inherited the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause?’ He (the Imam) said, ’Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, inherited his household assets and all that belonged to him (the Messenger of Allah).”’
